title: EKLAV: Elicited Key CoT Learning via Answer only superVision
abstract: arXiv:2607.25182v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reasoning distillation trains a student to reproduce both the teacher's chain-of-thought trace and its final answer. We ask whether the trace is better used as privileged training context than as an imitation target. EKLAV keeps the teacher's reasoning in the input sequence but supervises only the final task answer, applying a task-dependent placement that moves part or all of the trace into the prompt. On BRIGHT passage reranking, EKLAV improves average nDCG@10 at all four tested checkpoints across two model families, winning 41 of 48 model-domain comparisons while reducing training compute by up to 31.6% and inference time by up to 32.7%. On four held-out table-reranking benchmarks, it is the best of four conditions on three, exceeding full-trace distillation by 3.0 points and answer-only training without reasoning by 5.5 points on average. translated_title: EKLAV：通过仅答案监督引出关键思维链学习
translated_abstract: 推理蒸馏训练学生模型复现教师模型的思维链轨迹及其最终答案。我们探讨是否将思维链轨迹用作特权训练上下文比作为模仿目标更为有效。EKLAV将教师模型的推理保留在输入序列中，但仅对最终任务答案进行监督，并采用任务相关的放置策略，将部分或全部思维链轨迹移入提示中。在BRIGHT段落重排序任务上，EKLAV在两个模型家族的所有四个测试检查点上都提升了平均nDCG@10，在48个模型-领域对比中赢得41个，同时将训练计算量减少高达31.6%，推理时间减少高达32.7%。在四个留出的表格重排序基准上，它在四个条件中的三个中表现最佳，平均超过完整思维链蒸馏方法3.0分，超过无推理的仅答案训练5.5分。对生成轨迹的分析表明，EKLAV学生模型会延迟其首次口头表达的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: EKLAV将教师模型的思维链轨迹作为特权输入上下文而非模仿目标，仅对最终答案进行监督训练，在重排序任务上以更低的训练计算成本和推理时间超越了传统推理蒸馏方法。
en_tdlr: EKLAV uses the teacher's chain-of-thought as privileged input context rather than an imitation target, supervising only the final answer, and achieves better reranking performance than full-trace distillation while reducing training compute by up to 31.6% and inference time by up to 32.7%.
